name: scene_switch
description: Moves the game from one scene to another while it runs: from a menu to a level, from a level to the next, from a game over back to the menu. A door, a button or a timer is an entity that says where to go and what makes it go.

components.name: GoToScene
components.description: When one of its triggers fires, the game changes to the scene named by scene (a scene of the game's manifest). The triggers: use_action, when the action named by action is pressed (a menu button, a key bound in input.json); touch_layers, when the entity's Contacts touch a collider of one of these layers (a door, an exit: the entity needs a Collider and a Contacts); after_ticks, that many ticks after the entity appeared (a splash screen). A trigger left at its default is off. The entities of the old scene are removed, except those with a Persistent; elapsed is the entity's own tick count.

components.name: Persistent
components.description: The entity stays when the scene changes: the player, their inventory, a score. keep false has the same effect as not having the component.

systems.name: trigger
systems.description: Checks the triggers of every GoToScene each tick and asks for the scene change of the first one that fires; the app makes the change between two ticks.
